manifest.name: custom-field-def
manifest.description: One operator-defined customer property (backlog:434cc39a): a space-wide field with a key, an Italian label and a type (testo, numero, data, si-no, scelta). Definitions are space-wide: every scheda, filter and list column reads the same set. The framework never invents one: a definition is a human decision, and a value without a definition is refused.

migrations.name: create_custom_field_defs
migrations.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS custom_field_defs (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  source_key TEXT UNIQUE,
  field_key TEXT,
  label TEXT,
  field_type TEXT CHECK(field_type IN ('testo', 'numero', 'data', 'si-no', 'scelta')),
  options TEXT,
  created_by TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS custom_field_defs_field_key ON custom_field_defs(field_key);

bootstrap.name: pg_bootstrap_custom_field_defs
bootstrap.sql:
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "accordo";

CREATE TABLE "accordo"."custom_field_defs" (
  "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  "source_key" TEXT UNIQUE,
  "field_key" TEXT,
  "label" TEXT,
  "field_type" TEXT CHECK("field_type" IN ('testo', 'numero', 'data', 'si-no', 'scelta')),
  "options" TEXT,
  "created_by" TEXT,
  "created_at" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX "custom_field_defs_field_key"
  ON "accordo"."custom_field_defs"("field_key");
